locale.description: The interface language. Closed to the list — not free-form BCP-47.

responseLanguage.description: The language agents answer in (RN-618): `automatico` or ANY BCP-47 code whose language the server recognizes — an open list, unlike `locale`. Stored canonical (`pt-br` becomes `pt-BR`). An unrecognized code is a 400 that names the rule. Never changes `locale`.
